findings.evidence: A cut list (showing 40 of 599) from the dbff837f digest is one medium finding under the removal rule; the shown templates are restored and the four be9701bf lines are accepted drops, so the only remaining cost is this cut-list report.
findings.fix: No content to restore: the shown removed units are covered by record rows, and the four later lines are user-accepted drops. Leave the files as they are.

findings.evidence: Section 2 restates the R/K/TC ID convention and the Unknown-and-Open-Questions rule that sections 3, 3b and 8 already enforce.
findings.fix: Keep the NEVER-guess sentence in section 2 and point the ID and Unknown rules at the sections that apply them, so the convention is stated once.

findings.evidence: The tracking block says 'never guess a version or an assignee' without saying what a guessed version does to the fix.
findings.fix: Add the reason already used in SKILL.md section 2: a guessed build or assignee sends the fixer to the wrong change and the wrong person.

findings.evidence: The description names plans, cases, suites, a ship-or-block decision, Figma checks and bug reports, and its not-for line, but it does not name the deliverable keywords 'test plan', 'test case', 'regression suite' or 'bug report'.
findings.fix: Create manual QA test plans, executable test cases, regression and smoke suites, a ship-or-block release decision, Figma design-validation checklists and structured bug reports (repro rate, environment, Open Questions). Use when the user invokes qa-test-planner by name or /qa-test-planner, including a request that only implies the deliverable once the name is present: a password-reset or checkout test plan, test cases for a flow, a smoke or targeted regression suite, a ship-or-block decision, a Figma frame comparison, or a bug report whose rate or browser is unknown. Not for Cypress, Playwright, unit or API automation, fixing implementation code, or any QA request that does not name this skill.

findings.evidence: The plan row says to read references/test_plan_template.md 'at once' when the request names entry or exit criteria, a risk table, an executive summary, deliverables or a full plan, while section 3 tells the agent to write the short shape first and only then read that file.
findings.fix: Make the row match section 3: write the section 3 shape first, then read references/test_plan_template.md when the request names those full-plan sections.

findings.evidence: A plan request that names none of the listed sections keeps the short shape, but a request that only says 'full plan' and a request that names one section both load the whole template, with no default for which sections to add.
findings.fix: Default: a request that says only 'full plan' adds every section of references/test_plan_template.md; a request that names one section adds only that section, and say which you added.

findings.evidence: The file has 23 queries, 13 should-trigger and 10 should-not, and the negatives include real near-misses, but it has no train/validation split.
findings.fix: Split the 23 queries into a fixed train file of about 60 percent and a validation file of about 40 percent, keeping should-trigger and should-not proportional in both, and record the split so description changes are checked on the held-out set.

findings.evidence: Section 7 step 2.4 says 'run section 8 against the file and edit it to finish what the flags cannot express', while step 1.3 says those edits wait for authorization and step 1.4 says 'run or edit nothing unless the user authorizes it'.
findings.fix: In step 2.4, report the section 8 gaps and the proposed edits, then apply them only after the user authorizes the edit, matching steps 1.3 and 1.4.

findings.evidence: The smoke step says that with no catalog and no SMOKE- cases the agent writes the smoke set as Unknown and keeps one Blocked check, while the suite-tiers table still shows a six-case SMOKE-001 through SMOKE-006 example.
findings.fix: Add one line under the smoke example: those six IDs are an illustration of shape, and when the requester supplies no catalog and no SMOKE- cases the agent follows the scope step and writes the smoke set as Unknown instead of copying them.
